title: “We will not go gentle into that good night”
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: This quote is taken from Alan Gibbons’ “Campaign for the Book” Newsletter which details the many fights aganst library closures. Second favourite quote is from Anthony Suarez – “The Library gives people the tools they need to move off the bread line and onto a bank line”. 451 libraries (383 buildings and 68 mobiles) currently under threat or closed/left council control since 1/4/11 out of c.4517 in the UK – see tally by local authority link on right for the full picture.
